decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. It also includes support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment for additional damage and control. Arena of Glory provides extra value for your creatures, while Static Prison helps to control the opponent's board. The deck runs a low land count to ensure spells are consistently played on curve, with fetch lands like Windswept Heath and Arid Mesa providing color fixing. Overall, the strategy is to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to finish the game quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with enters-the-battlefield (ETB) effects to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. By blinking creatures like Flickerwisp and Overlord of the Balemurk with Ephemerate, the deck can repeatedly trigger powerful ETB effects to control the board and generate advantage. The deck also includes removal spells and hand disruption to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing a fast clock with aggressive creatures. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruptive plays.

The deck focuses on using a combination of cards to assemble a win condition without relying on lands. It includes disruptive spells to control the game and protect the combo pieces, along with cards like Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary components and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and abilities. It utilizes a variety of strategies to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on using blink effects to repeatedly bring back powerful creatures and gain value. By utilizing cards like Solitude and Ephemerate, the deck can remove threats from the board while also triggering enter-the-battlefield effects multiple times. The combination of aggressive creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and controlling elements such as Fatal Push and Thoughtseize creates a versatile strategy that can adapt to different matchups. The inclusion of cards like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter further adds to the deck's synergy and overall game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. It utilizes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to apply pressure, while cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Goblin Bombardment provide direct damage to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes land destruction elements with Static Prison and Arena of Glory to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient threats.

The main goal of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy with a variety of counter spells, removal, and card draw. By controlling the board and hand while gradually gaining card advantage, you can outlast your opponent and secure victory. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Snapcaster Mage to close out the game once you have established control. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently control the game and outvalue your opponent through a combination of disruption and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude while also disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Negation and hand disruption like Thoughtseize. A key strategy is to combine cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Fallaji Archaeologist to generate additional value and card advantage. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly to overwhelm the opponent and win the game before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing blink effects to protect and maximize their abilities. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly trigger beneficial enter-the-battlefield effects such as Thoughtseize and Solitude. This strategy allows the deck to disrupt opponents while maintaining a strong board presence. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of lands to support its color requirements and a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push to handle threats effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp up mana by untapping lands, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan and Scapeshift to search for key lands such as Vesuva and Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck aims to quickly assemble the Amulet Titan combo to overwhelm opponents with powerful land drops and creature summons. It also utilizes cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore to accelerate land drops and ensure consistent ramping. The inclusion of various utility lands and creature spells adds versatility and options for different game situations.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Pyretic Ritual and Ruby Medallion, while also utilizing cards like Manamorphose and Desperate Ritual to help fix the mana base. The combo potential comes from cards like Wish, Glimpse the Impossible, and Reckless Impulse, allowing the player to draw through their deck quickly to find key pieces. Wrenn's Resolve helps protect the combo pieces, while Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames provide additional combo potential and recursion. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through explosive plays and synergy between cards.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through countermagic and removal spells while generating card advantage with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Snapcaster Mage. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to close out the game quickly once the opponent's resources are depleted. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency in casting spells of all colors, allowing the deck to control the game at every stage.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing a combination of multicolored creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy involves playing efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, while supporting them with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Leyline Binding. Leyline of the Guildpact boosts the power of multicolored creatures, while Stubborn Denial provides protection against opposing spells. The mana base is built around fetch lands and a variety of dual lands to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed for the deck's powerful spells.

This deck focuses on assembling the Allosaurus Rider combo by using Eldritch Evolution and Neoform to search for Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant or Griselbrand and generate a lot of mana with Disciple of Freyalise and Generous Ent. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo with Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer, while also utilizing cards like Planar Genesis and Planeswalkers like Xenagos, God of Revels for additional support. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful threat.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan while controlling the board and generating card advantage. With a mix of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Counterspell, removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, and card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Snapcaster Mage, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent until it can win the game with its threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Thundertrap Trainer. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure it can cast all its spells efficiently.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creature plays, supported by burn and removal spells to clear the way and protect your creatures. The strategy involves utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to generate card advantage and pressure opponents, while also utilizing Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for powerful late-game threats. The inclusion of Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge provide additional reach and removal options to keep the pressure on opponents. Overall, this deck aims to establish early board presence and close out games quickly with efficient aggression.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck includes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Blood Moon, and Goblin Bombardment to apply pressure early and disrupt opponents' strategies. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats that can quickly close out games. The inclusion of cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Thraben Charm allow for some versatility and disruption against opposing strategies, making it a well-rounded aggressive deck in the Modern format.
